purpose: Content-addressed index of the immutable terminal artifacts published by the completed studies. Each committed file is the exact object-store body, byte for byte, so its SHA-256 can be recomputed and compared against the digest recorded at publication.

verification.manual: sha256sum research/artifacts/<file>  and compare against artifact_sha256 below
verification.note: The committed bytes are canonical JSON exactly as written by the publisher: sorted keys, no whitespace, no trailing newline. Reformatting a file will break its digest. .gitattributes marks them -text so git never rewrites line endings.

not_committed.reason_not_committed: This run predates the working session in which the other two artifacts were captured, and its object body was not retained locally. Retrieving it requires object-store credentials. Its digest and key are recorded here so it can be added later and verified against this manifest, and its complete numeric results are already mirrored in research/reports/kronos-structural-validity/results-summary.json.
not_committed.status: recorded but not yet independently verifiable from this repository

immutability_notice: These are published research records. They must never be edited, reformatted, regenerated or replaced. Any change to their bytes invalidates the digest recorded at publication and breaks the link between a result and the code that produced it.
